trigger.procedure: Association Setup (SMF parses UP IP Resource Info IE from a 'UPF' response)
trigger.message: Forged PFCP Association Setup Response (or any message) sent to SMF's PFCP port carrying a malformed User Plane IP Resource Information IE
trigger.ie_path: User Plane IP Resource Information IE
trigger.field: Malformed UP IP Resource Info (flag/length mismatch, missing TEID-range/NetInst/SourceIfc fields) that ogs_pfcp_parse_user_plane_ip_resource_info asserts on instead of rejecting
trigger.precondition: None — smf-pfcp-send.py sends the malformed packet directly to SMF (association_setup not required; the bug is in parsing the IE on receive)
